description: Web form security & UX audit — Find every HTML form on a public page and audit it: kind (login/signup/search/payment/newsletter/contact/upload), method, absolute action and host, fields with types/names/labels/autocomplete, hidden fields and anti-CSRF token detection. Flags password over HTTP, password forms using GET, POST without a CSRF token, uploads without multipart, missing password autocomplete, unlabeled fields, third-party form posts, card fields. Risk HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NONE + score/grade. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_forms
